sources.title: Tracing - OpenAI Agents SDK
sources.snippet: Tracing The Agents SDK includes built-in tracing, collecting a comprehensive record of events during an agent run: LLM generations, tool calls, handoffs, guardrails, and even custom events that occur. Using the Traces dashboard, you can debug, visualize, and monitor your workflows during development and in production.

sources.title: Fine-tuning a 35B model on agent traces beats bigger judges at lower ...
sources.snippet: LangChain and Fireworks showed that fine-tuning a 35B model on actual agent traces can match or beat the big frontier models at judging agent output. The cost drop is massive. Matching big models on narrow tasks changes where the real edge sits They took Qwen-3.5-35B and trained it on multi-turn traces from two agent setups.
